modern: Above, below, all around are the movements of the elements. But the motion of virtue is in none of these: it is something more divine, and, advancing by a way hardly noticed, it goes happily on its road.
original: Above, below, all around are the movements of the elements. But the motion of virtue is in none of these: it is something more divine, and advancing by a way hardly observed, it goes happily on its road.
